note: The diagonal Arzela-Ascoli extraction from a prescribed refinement, over countably many indices and multilinear in the token list, is carried by `first_surface`. The identification of derivative limits by integration by parts and the smooth table with convergence of every derivative are not in it: `first_surface` gives only continuity of S on generic points, and smoothness comes from a different table T in `serves`.

snippet.text:
theorem first_surface (H : TransferLip C f) (h : Bound C f) :
    ∃ g : Order, ∃ S P, RawLimits C (f.refine g) S P := by
  obtain ⟨t,P,hP⟩ := setMeshes C f H h
  let w := f.refine (meshMore t)
  let F (p : Indices C.book) (j) (x) := (P (w.per j)).read x (stack p)
  obtain ⟨u,v,hu⟩ := localAscoli (fun i : Indices C.book => Points i.1) (fun i => generic i.1) (fun i => genericOpen _)
    F (fun p => volume_oscillates _ _ (further _ _ H _) p.1 hP (stack p))
    (fun p x hx => extendsBound _ _ (h.further _) hP _ hx)
  let g := Order.mk t u
  let S := fitted v
  have Hs (n) (p : Fin n → C.book.Token) : Meets (generic n)
      (fun i x => (P ((f.refine g).per i)).read x p) (fun x => S.read x p) := by
    apply components S (fun i => P _) generic _ n p
    intro i; simpa only [S,knobs] using! hu i
  have hm : (f.refine g).Meshes C P := ⟨hP.continuous,hP.onK⟩
  have hV : (f.refine g).VolumePoints C S P := by
    intro n K hk he v ε hε
    simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using (Hs n v).uniform K he hk ε hε
  exact ⟨g,S,P,⟨fun n p => (Hs n p).continuousOn,hm,hV, Order.poses _ _ (h.further g) ⟨P,hm,hV⟩⟩⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Arzela-Ascoli (`localAscoli`) over all arities and token lists gives a strictly increasing refinement g and tables S, P with `RawLimits` (continuous S on `generic n`, locally uniform volume limits, ordered integral limit).

lemma serves (h : C.Makes) (h' : CenterPort C F) : ∃ T : Table C.book,∃ W : DiffPlan T, Cleaner S P T W F := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR⟩ := H.pin
  obtain ⟨Y,hY⟩ := lifts_model H.born H.census.integral R hR
  obtain ⟨T,ht,hT⟩ := awake S H.born H.census.regular hY.through_ties
  have hx := H.census.ready (Around.size_done h (h'.book _ _)) hT fun n w x hx => (ht _ _ hx).symm
  have hb := Extraction.Order.limits_basic h hT (f:=F) ⟨P,hx.mesh,hx.volume⟩
  have hv : Live T := fun n v t => Test.smearing t (T.smooth_read hT v).continuousOn
  have hi := sameWake (p := hv) ht hY
  exact ⟨T,Y.descends hv hi hT hb.toSymmetric,ht,hx,hb,hT,Y.readies hi hT hb.toSymmetric,Y.tilts hi hT hb.toSymmetric⟩

proof_context.conclusion: There is a smooth table T (`T.Smooth`) matching S on generic points with `RawLimits C F T P`.
